hypothesis: H24-FUSE fold-local 31-channel OOF-HGB fusing 27 multi-physics/LiDAR base channels with SAHG1 strike-projected scarp (G_sat), stable-Th K/U alteration (R_alt), basement/strain step (B_step), and hydrothermal conduit interaction (H_conduit), tested with and without training-only nuisance residualization (NuisanceResidualizer) and hydrothermal-conduit priority weighting
mechanism: Per-fold HistGradientBoostingClassifier trained strictly on visible faults inside fold['train'] with >=900 m negative buffer, evaluated across three preregistered arms (FUSE-RAW, FUSE-RESID, FUSE-HCW) inside a verified 9x9 discrete receptive-field support mask
named_non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan tufa-cemented beach ridges or welded-tuff stratigraphic ledges overlying buried intrusive contacts; road/mining access corridors along range fronts

road_m.limitation: Nearest Census road/vehicular-trail segment on a 100 m raster; not a complete pedestrian-path or travel-time model

claim_m.quality_policy: leading numeric QLTY code <=10; unknown/degraded/25 county-only excluded; broad geometries rejected
claim_m.limitation: PLSS legal-land approximations, often quarter-section precision; not exact historic claim stakes or workings

limitations: Boundaries are read from a figure, not published coordinates; edge uncertainty is a few km.
Tie lines extend at least 2 km into adjacent blocks (report), so membership within ~2 km of a boundary is inherently ambiguous.
Official flight-number to block mapping exists (report) but the profile CSV archives are S3-hosted and not anonymously downloadable.
